stages.candidate: Requires exact candidate bytes or a candidate-bound matrix and therefore does not block candidate creation.
stages.external: Requires owner, provider, production, legal, access or origin evidence outside local source execution.
stages.deferred: Explicitly outside the 1.2.0 release-bound scope or conditional on a later product decision.
